1999.o: Rath Yatra Festival, Swamishri celebrated the Rath Yatra festival by installing the murti of Harikrishna Maharaj on a small mobile chariot, It is a celebration symbolising the victory of God over
w: evil elements.

This evening at 6.15 am, Mr. Paul Boateng, Deputy Home Secretary and MP for Brent South, arrived for Swamishri's blessings. He was overwhelmed and happy to see Swamishri. During his speech in the evening assembly he expressed his feelings of respect and peace: "Sisters and Brothers. It's good to be with you here this afternoon and to be in the presence of His Holiness. I like so many of you on a Friday feel very much the burden of this world. All of us understand what a Friday afternoon is like after a long week's work. And I must share with you the fact that as I approached the temple, as I came down Brentfield Road this afternoon. For reasons I will not trouble you with, the burdens felt particularly heavy. But you know as I came in to this holy place I felt a great lightness begin to grow in my heart. And I saw as I came in, the first thing that one sees, is Ganesh. And I have to say the thing about Ganesh is that whatever state you are in when you see him somehow you want to smile, and that is the wonderful thing about his image and his presence. And then as I drew near to the chamber where His Holiness is to be found there was a sense of expectation, a sense of anticipation of being in his presence. And that sense of expectation and anticipation as one went into the room and saw him, and knelt before him, you have then a sense of profound goodness and power. You have a sense of somebody who is in some way the focus of a spiritual force that is almost tangible. It is as if you could touch it. And then the lightness in the heart and the smile on the lips becomes multiplied many, many, many times, and you forget it's Friday. And you forget you are a man, and you forget you are a father, and you forget you are a husband and you forget you are a minister and that's a good feeling! And it's just so good to be with you all because through ourselves, through what we are, with all our weaknesses, all our imperfections, we are able despite those weaknesses, despite those imperfections, despite those flaws, we are able to magnify that force that comes from Swamiji. Through our presence together, through our own love and veneration that force goes out into the world and we need that spiritual force at this time. We live in a shattered world, we live in a splintered world, a broken world, and with that spiritual force that is manifested in him, that force of good, that force of love we can again begin to build and to become whole. Thank God for manifesting himself in this way."

Morning & Evening Programs The Canada Yuvak Mandal presented a special presentation highlighting the virtues of a true sadhu during the evening cultural programme. Senior sadhus then explained how each one of these virtues can be found within Swamishri.
Swamishri blessed the evening assembly by explaining that the only means to liberation is through the manifest form of God.

In the afternoon the Home Secretary, Shri Lakshminarayan, came to meet Swamishri. After seeing the Akshardham complex he commented, “Akshardham is fantastic. It will also contribute greatly in the nurturing of the country’s character. I have been abroad 150 times. I’ve also seen Disneyland and Las Vegas. I’ve seen South Africa’s Fun City and everything else, but compared to them all what you have created is tremendously inspiring. You have superbly displayed the glory of India.”
Sadhus were returning to India from Dubai after a satsang tour. Mentioning this, the attendant sadhus said to Pramukh Swami Maharaj, "They have asked whether you want anything, so they can bring it."
Swamishri said with detachment, "We do not want anything."
An attendant said, "You want God."
Swamishri said naturally, "That I already have! Where is the need to ask! I already have God."

With detachment Swamishri said, "We do not want anything."
The attendant said, "You want God."
Swamishri said naturally, "He is already there! Where is the need to ask? I already have God."

Today Dipakbhai Amin came to meet Mahant Swami Maharaj and have darshan. He said to Swamishri, "At the time of the Dahegam pratishtha, you stayed at my home."
Swamishri said, "It was very cold at that time."
The sadhus were surprised and asked Dipakbhai, "When was this?"
Dipakbhai said, "It must have been '89 or '90!"
So it was something from 27 years ago.

The proof of Swamishri's memory is seen in many areas: people's names, addresses, special features, special virtues, special incidents, their seva, the people with them, the characters in skits, figures and so on. But this was the weather! He remembered even what the weather was like on one particular day 27 years ago!
Today Shri Rajnibhai Patel of Anand came to meet Mahant Swami Maharaj. Seeing him, Swamishri asked, "Did you open the second shop?"
Everyone standing around was surprised; no one understood what Swamishri had asked. When Rajnibhai was asked, he said:
"In 1987 everyone wanted to make me a supervisor, but I said no. So they took me to Mahant Swami Maharaj. He asked me, 'Why are you saying no?'
I said, 'I do not have the time.'
Then Swamishri asked, 'What do you do?'
I said, 'I have an electrical shop.'
Swamishri immediately said, 'If you opened a second shop, would you find the time?'
'Yes.'
'Then how would you find the time for that?'
'In that I would earn money, so I would find the time. I would make time.'
Hearing this, Swamishri said to me, 'Consider this your second shop. Just as money has value, in this you will get a hundred thousand times more reward than that.'
All my doubts were settled. I accepted the responsibility, and now I am serving as a director."
Today Mahant Swami Maharaj woke and went for his walk. The Yogi Vani class began. In it, the words of Yogiji Maharaj were read:
"What is a terrible time? When one sees fault in Bhagwan and in the devotee of Bhagwan."
Swamishri had everyone repeat this together. Then he said, "Now do what you want. It is your choice."
The next sentence came: "What is moksha? To sit and rise with these sadhus, to have katha and spiritual talks, to have their darshan and touch
that is moksha."
Adding to it, Swamishri said, "No one draws out such a meaning. What is written? Katha and spiritual talks. Not dislike and fault finding, not gossip. That has to be thrown out completely."

It was read further: "Maharaj himself was present, so why did he point to the great sadhu? Why did he not say, 'Associate with me'? Maharaj says that only by associating with the great sadhu do desires wear away."
Swamishri immediately had the book "Purushottam Bolya Prite" brought and said, "Page 290."

In surprise the page was opened, and exactly the same talk was found. In it Maharaj says, "The great means to remove one's nature and instincts is to love the great sadhu. If one speaks of removing one's nature without love and affection for the great sadhu, one does fundamental harm."
It was read further: "Purushottam dwells within my atma: one should hold this belief day and night."
Swamishri said, "This belief does not exist in the fourteen worlds. One should believe that the Gunatit is my atma." Then he said, "The last talk of the first chapter."
How attentively Swamishri reads whatever he reads! How much he reflects on it!

In the evening, Mahant Swami Maharaj came to the assembly being held as part of the shibir. Today a dialogue was presented here about how Karunashankar of Dabhoi introduced everyone to the manifest great sadhu. Then Karunashankar, the character in the dialogue, asked Swamishri as part of the dialogue, "Now I am going back to Akshardham. Is there anything you would like me to tell Shriji Maharaj and Bapa?"
Swamishri said, "I am doing my duty."
An answer of just a few words, but how much it says!

ds.t: Bapa has written it in a letter
w: In the next programme in the assembly there were questions and answers. The questions asked and the answers Mahant Swami Maharaj gave are as follows:
The question was asked: "Have you ever been troubled?"
Swamishri said, "Yes, I used to be."
"When?"
"When there is some confusion and people do not understand each other."
"Did you have any problems of your own that troubled you?"
"No."
"How did that happen?"
"By Bhagwan's grace," said Swamishri.
Another question was asked: "How can we become convinced that Bhagwan dwells in you completely?"
Swamishri said, "According to the words of the great sadhu."
It was asked further: "How should we understand that you and Swami Bapa are one?"
Swamishri said, "Bapa has written it in a letter."
The whole assembly hall filled with thunderous applause.

Referring to the tests Yogi Bapa had put him through after giving him diksha, Narayanmunidas Swami asked, "You were bound to Yogi Bapa with love, and when he himself put you to such tests, what thought did you keep at that time?"
"He is the master. Whatever he does," said Swamishri.
"How did you come to have such firmness?"
"Faith. He had shown love first, so I felt that this was just an act."
"Then how can everyone have such firmness?"
"Faith. The great sadhu loves us first, so we love him. If he did not, we would not have the strength," said Swamishri.

At the end, the volunteers prayed to Swamishri: today we have learned about the attainment. Tomorrow we are going to learn about being convinced of this attainment and loving it. So you will make it happen for us, won't you?
Swamishri gave an answer that plunges one into introspection: "It is Shriji Maharaj who needs it. He will make it happen."
Finally Narayanmunidas Swami asked, "What should we do to understand your glory and be convinced of it like that?"
"The easiest of all is firm love. Put aside all other cleverness," said Swamishri.

ds.t: They do not exist at all
w: Today, after the chesta, Narayanmunidas Swami asked Mahant Swami Maharaj, "When you say Jai Swaminarayan to all the sadhus, what do you think?"
At first Swamishri simply said, "Just like that."
To fathom Swamishri's heart, Narayanmunidas Swami asked another question: "Then how do you get such joy?"
Then Swamishri revealed the secret: "They are all muktas."
That is, Swamishri says "Jai Swaminarayan" to all the sadhus with this vision.
Then Narayanmunidas Swami asked, "Are they all residents of Akshardham? Or will they become so?"
"They already are."
"Even though they have faults of nature?"
"Yes."
"Then should we see it as that they will go away? Or should we see that they do not exist at all?"
"They do not exist at all."
"Then what about the fact that they are seen and cause problems?"
"That state is different. If one has that state, they are not seen at all. Wherever one looks, there is Ramji (Bhagwan); nothing else appears..."
"Then how does one attain such a state?" The key question was asked.

Swamishri said, "Seeing Bhagwan as faultless is a different matter. If one sees Bhagwan as faultless, all faults go away in a snap, like this. As you understand, so it spreads within you. Or rather, it is already so." In this way Swamishri spoke of deep secrets.
The sadhus said, "You have spoken very weighty talks."
Swamishri said, "There is no choice but to speak weighty talks. If we do not, when will it happen? Otherwise one just keeps splashing about in a puddle."
